_: jurassic_park_30th_le on RebelB's 'Jurassic Park 30TH LE (Stern 2023)' 2.0 (VPUniverse 20485, PAD-1511),
a SCRIPTED tribute (JPSalas's template, scripted by RebelB, JPSalas & Nailbuster; PuP pack) with
its own 3D toys (a moving T-Rex, the jeep, the helicopter). It sits beside JPSalas & marty's
4.02 (jurassic_park_le.shadow.json): both are listed and either can be patched.
Fitted to the rig's drawing on seven anchors (outlanes, return lanes, the three pops) at an
Where the table has one trigger and the machine two optos (the orbits, the Newton ball)
the trigger pulses both (`also`). The table's teleport holes (k1->K2 halfpipe, k3->K4
right ramp, k11/k14->k12) keep their hop; Lock (the left ramp's end) passes its ball
straight on out of Kicker2. Its T-Rex head only moves from the table's own rules, so on
the machine's code it stays still; its timers are quieted too. The Escape Nublar Challenge
copy in the download is the same playfield with other table rules (one ball), which the
machine's code replaces: `detect_not` keeps it off this map (BallsPerGame = 1).
Its posts and the raptor pen's door are droppable walls that stand UP until the table's own
game drops them, and that game never starts: they drop once its init is done (after_init),
the subs of its rules that raise them are quieted, and plock (left return lane) and plock2
(control room) with plock3 (the raptor pen's lock) are the machine's two up posts it has here (UP POST-TOP, at the top centre, has none). The door stays down: the Pro has none.
The jeep (jptruck) is drawn at 100 (was 130, too big). Its Newton ball is only painted on the
playfield, smaller than a ball: two kickers hold real balls there (retrofit_items), the front one
and the one under the jeep's bumper, and a wall round both takes the knock: it pulses both Newton
optos and turns the jeep round once (PadJeepTimer); the car itself turns nothing. The third
flipper is SolRFlipper2 (`flippers`). The control room roof's picture (Wall022) is lifted to 60,
over a ball's top, and the wireforms RebelB drew over the photographed ones are hidden (RVIS 0)
but still carry the ball. SHOOT AGAIN is the table's own light. RebelB's own copies of the game's effects
("LEFT BALL LOST", "SUPPLY DROP 1" ...) are muted: the machine plays the real ones.

extra_vbs:
'---- PAD (PAD-1511): the machine's up posts are the table's plock, plock2 and plock3
Sub PadReturnPost(e) : plock.IsDropped = Not e : End Sub
' the machine's control room post stands at its raptor pit's foot and holds a captured raptor
' ball (6 s on the rig): RebelB split it in two, plock2 in the control room lane and plock3 in
' the raptor pen, the post his own rules raise for a capture; both rise with it
Sub PadControlRoomPost(e) : plock2.IsDropped = Not e : plock3.IsDropped = Not e : End Sub
'---- PAD (PAD-1511): the jeep turns round once when the ball knocks the Newton ball
Dim PadJeepStep : PadJeepStep = -1
Dim PadJeepA : PadJeepA = Array(-9.11, 49.54, 67.6, 74.11, 77.09, 78.5, 78.97, 78.68, 77.53, 75.03, 69.7, 56, 9.11, -49.54, -67.6, -74.11, -77.09, -78.5, -78.97, -78.68, -77.53, -75.03, -69.7, 124)
Dim PadJeepB : PadJeepB = Array(-78.83, -72.86, -59.88, -45.68, -31.14, -16.47, -1.76, 12.96, 27.64, 42.22, 56.54, 70, 78.83, 72.86, 59.88, 45.68, 31.14, 16.47, 1.76, -12.96, -27.64, -42.22, -56.54, 250)
Dim PadJeepC : PadJeepC = Array(-131.65, -71.54, -51.99, -43.88, -39.13, -35.67, -32.71, -29.8, -26.51, -22.18, -15.22, 0, 48.35, 108.46, 128.01, 136.12, 140.87, 144.33, 147.29, 150.2, 153.49, 157.82, 164.78, 0)
Sub PadJeepTurn
	If PadJeepStep >= 0 Then Exit Sub
	PadJeepStep = 0 : PadJeepTimer.Enabled = True
End Sub
Sub PadJeepTimer_Timer
	If PadJeepStep > UBound(PadJeepA) Then
		PadJeepStep = -1 : PadJeepTimer.Enabled = False : Exit Sub
	End If
	jptruck.RotAndTra0 = PadJeepA(PadJeepStep)
	jptruck.RotAndTra1 = PadJeepB(PadJeepStep)
	jptruck.RotAndTra2 = PadJeepC(PadJeepStep)
	PadJeepStep = PadJeepStep + 1
End Sub
